name: bin-plain
prompt: A small municipal waste skip, a squat dark slate-grey steel container with sloping sides, two lifting lugs and a slightly dented rim, heaped above the rim with crushed kraft cardboard cartons and crumpled plain snack pouches in muted colours, one flattened carton leaning against its side, the skip filling about two thirds of the frame width. Soft 3D render in a premium product-illustration style: matte clay-like materials with real surface detail, studio softbox lighting from the upper left, gentle ambient occlusion and a soft contact shadow, three-quarter view, centred with generous margin so nothing touches the frame edges, natural muted colours, calm and modern like Apple or Monzo marketing art. Transparent background with no floor surface, only the soft contact shadow. No people, no hands. No text, letters or logos anywhere.
note: the design system's render style, without its usual 'fresh green accents', since green means a good exit on this page; it rendered as a plastic bin rather than a steel skip, which reads the same
postprocess: contact shadow: pale see-through pixels outside the object recoloured to #0b1510 at 62% of their alpha, so the shadow reads as shadow on light and dark grounds; then a 768x768 WebP, cwebp -q 85 -alpha_q 100 -resize 768 768; the PNG original stays local in src/
